database_summary: Small world/country/city dataset (similar to classic 'world' sample). Three tables: country (master list of countries, descriptive attributes, current-state demographic/economic metrics), city (cities belonging to countries, population and location attributes), countrylanguage (languages per country with percent and official flag). Relations: city.CountryCode -> country.Code, countrylanguage.CountryCode -> country.Code. No temporal history tables; rows represent current/latest snapshots or descriptive attributes. Typical analytic uses: country-level aggregation, city counts and population summaries per country/region/continent, language composition and official language filters.

accepted.name: country_dim
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  Code,
  Name,
  Continent,
  Region,
  SurfaceArea,
  IndepYear,
  Population,
  LifeExpectancy,
  GNP,
  GNPOld,
  LocalName,
  GovernmentForm,
  HeadOfState,
  Capital,
  Code2
FROM country
accepted.description: Canonical country projection with descriptive attributes and numeric measures. Use this when you need one-row-per-country country metadata for joins or filtering. | Use for: List countries by continent/region; Filter countries by life expectancy, GNP, population; Join countries to cities or languages

accepted.name: city_dim
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  ID,
  Name,
  CountryCode,
  District,
  Population
FROM city
accepted.description: Canonical city projection (one row per city) preserving identifying and location columns plus Population. Use for city-level filters, joins and aggregations. | Use for: Top-N cities by population; Cities in a given country/region; Aggregate city populations by country

accepted.name: countrylanguage_dim
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  CountryCode,
  Language,
  IsOfficial,
  Percentage
FROM countrylanguage
accepted.description: Canonical projection of countrylanguage preserving IsOfficial and Percentage. Useful for language composition and official-language filters. | Use for: List official languages by country; Compute language shares; Join languages to country metadata

accepted.name: country_with_capital
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.Code,
  c.Name,
  c.Continent,
  c.Region,
  c.SurfaceArea,
  c.IndepYear,
  c.Population,
  c.LifeExpectancy,
  c.GNP,
  c.GNPOld,
  c.LocalName,
  c.GovernmentForm,
  c.HeadOfState,
  c.Capital,
  c.Code2,
  city.ID AS ID,
  city.Name AS Name,
  city.CountryCode AS CountryCode,
  city.District AS District,
  city.Population AS Population
FROM country c
LEFT JOIN city ON c.Capital = city.ID
accepted.description: Each country enriched with its capital city's core attributes (if Capital references a city.ID). One row per country; capital columns are NULL when no matching city exists. Use when you need country-level info alongside capital name or capital population. | Use for: Show country with its capital name or capital population; Filter countries whose capital meets criteria (e.g., population); Join capital attributes into country-level reports

accepted.name: country_city_agg
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  CountryCode,
  COUNT(*) AS city_count,
  SUM(Population) AS city_population_sum,
  MAX(Population) AS city_population_max,
  AVG(Population) AS city_population_avg
FROM city
GROUP BY CountryCode
accepted.description: Aggregated city measures per country: number of cities, total population of cities, max city population, avg city population. One row per country. Use when comparing country-level city concentration or joining to country metrics. | Use for: Compare number of cities and city population totals by country; Compute urban concentration metrics; Join city aggregates to country to compute metrics like % of national population in reported cities

accepted.name: country_language_agg
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  CountryCode,
  COUNT(*) AS language_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN IsOfficial = 'T' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS official_language_count,
  SUM(Percentage) AS language_percentage_sum
FROM countrylanguage
GROUP BY CountryCode
accepted.description: Language counts and official-language counts per country, plus sum of declared Percentage. One row per country. Useful for language diversity or quality checks. | Use for: Count languages and official languages per country; Validate that language percentages approximately sum to 100; Filter countries by language diversity

accepted.name: country_denorm
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.Code,
  c.Name,
  c.Continent,
  c.Region,
  c.SurfaceArea,
  c.IndepYear,
  c.Population,
  c.LifeExpectancy,
  c.GNP,
  c.GNPOld,
  c.LocalName,
  c.GovernmentForm,
  c.HeadOfState,
  c.Capital,
  c.Code2,
  coalesce(cc.city_count, 0) AS city_count,
  coalesce(cc.city_population_sum, 0) AS city_population_sum,
  coalesce(cl.language_count, 0) AS language_count,
  coalesce(cl.official_language_count, 0) AS official_language_count,
  coalesce(cl.language_percentage_sum, 0) AS language_percentage_sum
FROM country c
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT CountryCode, COUNT(*) AS city_count, SUM(Population) AS city_population_sum, MAX(Population) AS city_population_max
  FROM city
  GROUP BY CountryCode
) cc ON cc.CountryCode = c.Code
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT CountryCode, COUNT(*) AS language_count, SUM(CASE WHEN IsOfficial = 'T' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS official_language_count, SUM(Percentage) AS language_percentage_sum
  FROM countrylanguage
  GROUP BY CountryCode
) cl ON cl.CountryCode = c.Code
accepted.description: Denormalized country rows joined with aggregated city metrics and aggregated language metrics. One row per country combining core country attributes with city and language summaries for easier reporting without multiplicative joins. | Use for: Country-level reports combining demographic, city and language summaries; Filter countries by combined metrics (e.g., countries with many cities and official languages); Compute % of population in listed cities by dividing city_population_sum by Population

accepted.name: city_rank_within_country
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  ID,
  Name,
  CountryCode,
  District,
  Population,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY CountryCode ORDER BY Population DESC) AS city_population_rank
FROM city
accepted.description: Cities ranked by Population within their CountryCode. One row per city with a rank column city_population_rank (1 = largest population in that country). Use this for top-k-per-country queries by filtering on city_population_rank. | Use for: Top city per country (WHERE city_population_rank = 1); Top-N cities per country (WHERE city_population_rank <= N); Compare city ranks between countries

accepted.name: country_gnp_per_capita_rank
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  Code,
  Name,
  Continent,
  Region,
  GNP,
  Population,
  CASE WHEN Population = 0 OR Population IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (GNP / Population) END AS gnp_per_capita,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CASE WHEN Population = 0 OR Population IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (GNP / Population) END DESC) AS gnp_per_capita_rank
FROM country
accepted.description: Countries with computed GNP per capita and rank order across all countries. One row per country with gnp_per_capita and gnp_per_capita_rank. Use to select top or bottom countries by GNP per capita. | Use for: Top-N countries by GNP per capita; Compare GNP per capita across continents or regions

accepted.name: city_running_population_by_country
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  ID,
  Name,
  CountryCode,
  District,
  Population,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY CountryCode ORDER BY Population DESC) AS city_population_rank,
  SUM(Population) OVER (PARTITION BY CountryCode ORDER BY Population DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS city_population_cume
FROM city
accepted.description: Cities ordered by descending Population within each CountryCode with a running total of population (cumulative city populations). One row per city with city_population_rank and city_population_cume. Useful for share-of-city-population analyses and top-k cumulative coverage queries. | Use for: Compute how many top cities cover X% of country city population (join to country.Population externally); Find cumulative shares and thresholds for urban planning

accepted.name: language_official_flag_norm
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  CountryCode,
  Language,
  IsOfficial,
  CASE WHEN IsOfficial = 'T' THEN 1 WHEN IsOfficial = 'F' THEN 0 ELSE NULL END AS official_flag,
  Percentage
FROM countrylanguage
accepted.description: Normalized countrylanguage with IsOfficial cast to boolean-like 1/0 (official_flag). Keeps original IsOfficial text for traceability. One row per (CountryCode, Language). Use when you want boolean semantics for filtering/aggregation. | Use for: Filter official languages using official_flag = 1; Aggregate official language counts using official_flag; Compute shares among official vs non-official languages

accepted.name: country_population_density
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  Code,
  Name,
  Continent,
  Region,
  Population,
  SurfaceArea,
  CASE WHEN SurfaceArea = 0 OR SurfaceArea IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (Population / SurfaceArea) END AS population_density
FROM country
accepted.description: Per-country population density computed as Population / SurfaceArea. One row per country. Use when comparing density across countries, regions, or continents. | Use for: Rank countries by population density; Compare density by region or continent
